title: Titanium Pocket Comb

faq.q: Why use titanium for titanium pocket comb?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V offers the optimal balance of strength, corrosion resistance, and fatigue life for titanium pocket comb.

faq.q: How is a titanium pocket comb manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium pocket comb is manufactured using CNC milling; PVD coating (ISO 27874); Diamond-cut beveling; AFP nano-coating. Each step is critical to achieving the required mechanical properties and dimensional tolerances.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for titanium pocket comb?
faq.a: Stainless steel (heavier, less fatigue life), aluminum (lower strength)

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium pocket comb?
faq.a: Titanium Pocket Comb components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348, ASME. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply depending on the application and regulatory requirements.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium pocket comb?
faq.a: With proper material selection (Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V) and manufacturing process control (thread rolling, heat treatment), titanium titanium pocket comb components exhibit excellent fatigue life and corrosion resistance in service.

faq.q: What surface treatments are available for titanium pocket comb?
faq.a: Common surface treatments include Passivation ASTM F86. These enhance corrosion resistance, wear properties, and aesthetic appearance.
